messages:
marco: Quick report: after today's SDK bump the sample that runs on the Edge runner started failing to resolve subpath imports like `@redwood/sdk/lib/request`. Edge runtime throws "Module not found".

sasha: hmm. did we change `exports` in package.json? If we accidentally removed the `./lib/*` subpath mapping that would do it.

marco: I pulled the published package and the exports are now just: `{ ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js" } }` 1# no subpaths and no require.

elaine: that explains it. Our edge bundles (Cloudflare/Netlify Edge) rely on subpath mappings to pick smaller entry points. Also noticed the `types` field points to `dist/esm/index.d.ts` which the CJS-only consumers can't find when the bundler rewrites imports.

edge-bot: edge-smoke job 211 failed: cannot resolve "@redwood/sdk/lib/request" in worker bundle. https://ci.internal/edge/211

marco: the change slipped through because our pack step strips unused exports when building a minimal manifest. pack-bot, did manifest-merge v3 run today?

pack-bot: publish workflow used manifest-merge v3. It collapses subpath globs unless preserveGlobs=true in the config. Current config had preserveGlobs=false. See pack log: https://ci.internal/pack/314

sasha: immediate fix: republish a patch that restores "./lib/*": "./dist/lib/*.js" and "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" and include both import/require for the root. Also add an edge-smoke test to CI that bundles the sample with the edge bundler.

elaine: additionally, we should add a test that verifies typings resolution for both ESM and CJS consumers. I can add a tiny TypeScript compile job in samples that imports the subpath and expects no errors.

marco: ok I'll open the rollback+patch PR. Also, let's add a lint that prevents preserveGlobs=false in pack config and a note in devex README about subpath exports and edge compatibility.

marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1301 (rollback exports + add CI edge-smoke + types check)

edge-bot: rerun edge-smoke job queued (job 212)

elaine: long-term: consider shipping a tiny helper `scripts/pack-verify.js` that unpacks the tarball and validates subpaths + types are present. That would have caught this earlier.

sasha: agreed. Also callout for SDK changelog: this is breaking for edge consumers; we should mark it in the release notes and ping developer-experience folks.

marco: will coordinate the release notes and post a short announcement when PR merges. Thanks all.
